serverInfo.name: Civify MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Official MCP server for Civify AI Career Platform (Resume Parsing, ATS Scoring, Tailoring, PII Masking, Kanban Applications, and Pay-Per-CV).

authentication.description: Dynamic per-session authentication supported (civify_login, civify_register, or civify_set_api_key).

apiKey.description: Optional Civify Developer API key (starts with 'cv-fy-'). If omitted, you can authenticate interactively in chat.

tools.name: civify_set_api_key
tools.description: Set or switch the active Civify API key for this agent session.

tools.name: civify_login
tools.description: Sign in to Civify using email or username and password.

tools.name: civify_verify_2fa
tools.description: Complete two-factor authentication (2FA) by submitting the OTP code sent to email.

tools.name: civify_register
tools.description: Register a new Civify user account.

tools.name: civify_get_account
tools.description: Get current authenticated user account profile, subscription tier, remaining AI token balance, and CV credits.

tools.name: civify_logout
tools.description: Log out and clear active authentication credentials from this session.

tools.name: civify_get_pay_per_cv_pricing
tools.description: Get public localized Pay-Per-CV pricing (USD and EGP regional rates).

tools.name: civify_purchase_cv_pass
tools.description: Initiate checkout for a Pay-Per-CV unlock pass (single CV or 3-pack).

tools.name: civify_check_cv_entitlement
tools.description: Check if a specific resume currently has an active 30-day unwatermarked pass.

tools.name: civify_scrape_job
tools.description: Scrape and extract structured job requirements from a URL (LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, etc.).

tools.name: civify_parse_cv
tools.description: Parse a resume document (PDF, DOCX, image) into structured JSON schema.

tools.name: civify_tailor_cv
tools.description: Tailor a candidate's resume against a target job description using AI.

tools.name: civify_score_ats
tools.description: Calculate ATS compatibility score (0-100) and section quality audit.

tools.name: civify_mask_pii
tools.description: Sanitize personal identifiable information (name, phone, email, address) and generate anonymized PDF.

tools.name: civify_generate_pdf
tools.description: Render high-fidelity PDF from structured resume data using Civify templates.

tools.name: civify_track_application
tools.description: Record a job application in the candidate's Civify Kanban board.

tools.name: civify_list_applications
tools.description: List all tracked job applications from the candidate's Civify Kanban board.
